blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Knowledge Pull Requests (KPRs), a framework for continual document authoring that makes each change interpretable. Documents require ongoing revision as new knowledge surfaces from other sources, languages, or times, but existing approaches either edit with no account of what knowledge changed or regenerate from scratch. A KPR integrates new knowledge into a document by extracting claims, filtering and routing them to sections, and flagging conflicts with existing content, producing a ChangeLog that separates what knowledge changes (claim proposal) from how the text changes (document diff). We evaluate KPRs on revising Wikipedia across languages and updating query-driven reports on RAGTIME. KPRs integrate more information and better preserve existing content than rewriting from sources or regenerating from scratch, while adding the most information per token generated. A KPR-revised article also grounds question answering better than a frontier model with search, which does not surface knowledge documented only in other languages. 1 1 1 https://github.com/alexmartin1722/kpr
blocks.zh: 我们引入了知识拉动请求(KPRs),这是一个持续编写文件的框架,可以解释每个变化。 文件需要不断修订,因为新的知识来自其他来源、语言或时间,但现有方法要么在编辑时没有说明知识的变化,要么从零开始再生。 KPR 将新知识整合到文档中,方法是提取债权,过滤并引导它们到章节,并标出与现有内容的冲突,生成一个ChangLog,将知识的改变(索赔建议)与文本的改变(diff文件)区分开来. 并更新关于RAGTIME的由查询驱动的报告。 与从源头重写或从零开始再生相比,KPR集成更多的信息并更好地保存了现有内容,同时增加了每生成一个令牌中最多的信息. 与搜索的前沿模式相比,《韩国减贫战略》修订后的文章也提出了更好的问题答案,因为搜索并不显示仅以其他语言记录的知识。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Many important documents maintained by humans and systems are never truly finished. Wikipedia articles, technical documentation, intelligence reports, and more require ongoing maintenance as knowledge surfaces from new sources, other languages, or later time periods. To incorporate these changes, one may prompt a language model with an existing document alongside new sources Logan IV et al. (2022) ; Gangi Reddy et al. (2026) , but this gives no account of what facts are added or overwritten. Query-driven systems do not attempt updating, instead generating documents from scratch for each query Shao et al. (2024) ; OpenAI (2025) ; Google (2025) . If the query is asked again or new sources surface, the entire generation pipeline reruns.
blocks.zh: 许多由人类和系统维护的重要文件从未真正完成. 维基百科的文章,技术文献,情报报告,以及更多需要持续的维护,因为知识会从新来源,其他语言中浮出水面,或者在后期. 为了纳入这些变化,人们可能会在新的资料来源Logan IV等人(2022年)之外,推出一个带有现有文件的语言模型; Reddy等人(2026年),但这并没有说明哪些事实被添加或被覆盖. 由查询驱动的系统并不试图更新,而是从头生成每个查询Shao等人的文件(2024年);OpenAI (2025年);Google (2025年). 如果再次被询问或新来源表面,则整个生成管道会重新运行.

blocks.en: Even Wikipedia, the canonical continually authored knowledge base, tracks edits only as raw text diffs, recording which words changed and not what knowledge did. With millions of edits per month and a finite pool of volunteers, reviewers struggle to assess whether an edit introduces new facts, corrects outdated ones, or conflicts with existing content Franzmeyer et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 甚至维基百科,即Cononic 持续地编译的知识库,只将编辑作为原始文本diffs,记录哪些字变了,而不是知识做了什么. 由于每月编辑数百万个,志愿者人数有限,审查人员难以评估编辑是引入了新的事实、纠正了过时的事实,还是与Franzmeyer等人(2024年)的现有内容相冲突。

blocks.zh: 图1:知识拉动 要求更新一份主要文件,将信息来源的信息作为可审查的变更日志:索赔提案(不存在或相互冲突的来源索赔)和文件Diff(文字改动)。

blocks.en: Reducing this burden requires moving from text-level diffs to knowledge-level proposals — an interpretable account of what claims are being added and how they relate to existing content. Software engineering solved an analogous problem with the Pull Request , a proposal of changes to a code base that can be inspected, discussed, and merged. We introduce Knowledge Pull Requests (KPRs), the equivalent for documents ( Figure 1 ). A KPR extracts claims from a set of sources , filters and routes them into a main document , and flags conflicts, producing a ChangeLog : a reviewable artifact separating what knowledge changes (claim proposal) from how the text changes (document diff).
blocks.zh: 减轻这种负担需要从文本一级的建议转向知识一级的建议——可解释地说明正在增加哪些权利要求,以及它们与现有内容的关系。 软件工程解决了一个类似的问题,即Pull Request(Pull Request),这个修改代码基础的建议可以被检查,讨论和合并. 我们引入了知识拉动请求(KPRs),相当于文件(图1). KPR从一系列来源中提取索赔,过滤并引导它们进入主要文件,并标出相冲突之处,生成一个 ChangeLog:一个可审查的文物,将知识的变化(索赔建议)与文本的变化(diff文件)区分开来。

blocks.en: We study continual document authoring in two settings: revision, adding information about an unchanged world, and update, synchronizing a document with a changed world Katsuno and Mendelzon (1991) . For revision, we integrate knowledge into an English Wikipedia article from its counterparts in other languages, where coverage is often uneven, so facts documented in one language may be absent from the English article and hard to reach through English search. For update, query-driven reports must be kept current as new sources extend, supersede, or contradict them. We study this with three constructed variants of RAGTIME ( Lawrie et al., 2026 ) : temporal, conflict, and balanced.
blocks.zh: 我们研究在两种情况下继续编写文件:修订、增加关于一个不变世界的信息、更新、使一份文件与一个变化世界Katsuno和Mendelzon(1991年)同步。 为了修订,我们将知识从其他语言的对应方纳入英文维基百科的一篇文章中,其中的涵盖范围往往不均匀,因此在英文文章中可能没有用一种语言记录的事实,通过英语搜索难以达到. 为了更新,查询驱动的报告必须随着新来源的扩展、取代或相互矛盾而不断更新。 我们用 " RAGTIME " (Lawrie等人,2026年)的三个构筑变体来研究这个问题:时间、冲突和平衡。

blocks.en: We compare KPRs against three baselines. The first rewrites the document conditioned on the new sources, but never makes explicit what an edit adds or overwrites Gangi Reddy et al. (2026) . The second conditions on claims extracted from those sources, but without a claim proposal to filter them. The third regenerates the document from scratch over all sources, discarding the existing one. We evaluate these methods intrinsically, by the faithfulness and completeness of the rewrite, extrinsically, by its usefulness as a grounding source for downstream question answering, and by the cost of adding and reviewing its changes.
blocks.zh: 与三个基线相比, 首个重写以新来源为条件的文档,但从未明确编辑添加或覆盖Gangi Reddy等人的内容(2026年). 从这些来源提取的索赔的第二个条件,但没有提出过滤这些条件的索赔建议。 第三个是将文档从头到尾从所有来源重新生成,丢弃了现有的一个. 我们从本质上评估这些方法,从外在的改写的忠实性和完整性,从它作为回答下游问题的基础来源的用处,以及从增加和审查其变化的成本来评估。

blocks.en: Across both settings, KPRs outperform these baselines, integrating more of the new information and better preserving the existing document. When revising Wikipedia, the revised article is a stronger grounding source than the original, any baseline, or a frontier model with web search, which does not surface this knowledge. When updating RAGTIME, KPRs flag conflicts between sources rather than silently resolving them, holding precision where conditioning on raw text is misled. Across tasks, we find that conditioning on claims rather than raw source text yields more complete documents. Additionally, filtering those claims before the rewrite raises both precision and recall, while concentrating the changes into contiguous edits a reviewer can approve.
blocks.zh: 在这两种设置中,知识管理方案都超过了这些基线,纳入了更多的新信息并更好地保存了现有文件。 在修订维基百科时,修订后的文章是比起原作,任何基线,或带有网络搜索的前沿模型更强大的地基来源,不会浮出这个知识. 在更新RAGTIME时,KPRs会标出来源之间的冲突,而不是默默地解决,在原始文本上的调值被误导的地方保持精确. 在各项任务中,我们发现,对索赔的限定而不是原始来源文本产生更完整的文件。 此外,在改写之前过滤这些索赔要求,既提高精确度又提高召回率,同时将修改集中在一个审查者可以批准的毗连编辑上。

blocks.en: We contribute: (1) Knowledge Pull Requests , which add knowledge to a document as a reviewable ChangeLog , and (2) evidence that KPRs outperform existing document-updating approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) 知识拉动请求,将知识作为可审查的变换日志添加到文件中;(2) 证据表明,知识共享程序比现有的更新文件方法要好。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Formal epistemology studies how to incorporate new information into an existing body of belief ( Gärdenfors, 1988 ; Fermé and Hansson, 2011 ) . The AGM framework ( Alchourrón et al., 1985 ) operates over belief sets closed under logical consequence, but requiring the belief state to contain every sentence its members entail is poorly suited to a document. This is refined by belief bases ( Hansson, 1992 ; Hansson, 1999 ) , which model finite sets of explicitly held sentences and move closer to how belief is expressed in language. Belief revision further distinguishes revision , learning more about a static world, from update , where the world itself changes ( Katsuno and Mendelzon, 1991 ) . These frameworks, however, model belief change over sentences and their logical relations alone, without reference to the justifications behind them, operating at too high a level of abstraction ( Pollock, 1987 ; Pollock and Gillies, 2000 ) . Our KPRs take this a step further, operating over natural-language claims rather than formal sentences and producing a ChangeLog that separates the knowledge-level claim proposal from the text-level diff. Our experiments cover both settings: revising English Wikipedia from other-language editions (revision) and updating reports as sources evolve (update).
blocks.zh: 正式的流行病学研究如何将新信息纳入现有的信仰体系(Gärdenfors,1988;Fermé和Hansson,2011.). AGM框架(Alchourrón等,1985年)在逻辑结果下关闭了信仰设定,但要求信仰国包含其成员的每一个句子却不适合于文件。 信仰基础对这一点作了完善(Hansson,1992年;Hansson,1999年),它模拟了明确持有的有限度的几套句子,并更接近信仰如何用语言表达。 信仰修正进一步区分了修正,更多地了解一个静态的世界,以及世界本身变化的更新(Katsuno和Mendelzon,1991年)。 然而,这些框架的模式信念在句子及其逻辑关系上有所改变,而没有提及背后的理由,其抽象程度过高(Pollock,1987;Pollock和Gillies,2000)。 我们 KPRs更进一步,在自然语言索赔而不是正式句子上运作,并制作一个ChangleLog,将知识层次的索赔建议与文本层次的diff分开。 我们的实验涵盖了两种设置:从其他语言版本(修订版)中修改英文维基百科,随着来源的演变(更新)更新报告.

blocks.en:
A language model’s knowledge is fixed at a training cutoff and grows stale as the world changes ( Jang et al., 2022 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Vu et al., 2024 ) . A common approach updates the model’s parameters: either locating and overwriting factual associations in the weights ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) or isolating knowledge in modular adapters that can be added, removed, or swapped ( Pfeiffer et al., 2021 ; Fleshman et al., 2025 ; Fleshman and Durme, 2025 ) . A complementary line instead updates the source text models rely on. Here Wikipedia is a natural target: it is a standard ingredient of LLM pretraining corpora ( Soldaini et al., 2024 ; Groeneveld et al., 2024 ) and among the most frequently cited domains grounding the answers of LLMs and AI search ( Semrush, 2025 ; theStacc, 2026 ; Wikimedia Foundation, 2023 ; Wikimedia Foundation, 2025 ) . Logan IV et al. (2022) and Gangi Reddy et al. (2026) rewrite Wikipedia articles to reflect new sources, and Spangher et al. (2022) model the revision histories of news articles. However, editing weights and text alike treat updating as end-to-end
rewriting, yielding a revised artifact without surfacing which claims changed or how
they conflict with existing content, and offering a reviewer no interpretable
record of the update.

blocks.en: Claims—atomic, independently verifiable propositions—have become a standard unit for reasoning about factual content, for two reasons. First, claims are more interpretable than sentences. Building on the Pyramid method ( Nenkova and Passonneau, 2004 ) , which scores content by atomic facts (Summary Content Units) rather than whole sentences, FActScore ( Min et al., 2023 ) and VeriScore ( Song et al., 2024 ) decompose model outputs into subclaims and verify each against evidence, showing that atomic claims support more reliable and interpretable factuality judgments than sentence- or passage-level assessment. Second, claims are more universal and independent of the form of their context than task-specific alternatives ( Voorhees, 2004 , e.g., nuggets;) , transferring even to other modalities ( Jing et al., 2024 ; Martin et al., 2026 ) . These two properties motivate operating over claims rather than whole documents. Claims expose exactly which fact is being asserted, distinguishing our approach from methods that update articles conditioned on raw text ( Gangi Reddy et al., 2026 ) . Reducing sources to claims first makes explicit what knowledge each change contributes.
blocks.zh: 由于两个原因,主张――原子性、可独立核查的提议――已成为对事实内容进行推理的标准单位。 首先,索赔比判刑更能解释。 基于"平分法"(Nenkova and Passonneau, 2004.),它按照原子事实(简要内容单位)而不是整个句子对内容进行评分,FActScore(Min等,2023.)和VeriScore(Song等,2024.)将模型输出分解为子索赔,并对照证据对每个模型进行校验,表明原子索赔支持更可靠和可解释的事实质量判断,而不是句子或通过级评估. 第二,权利主张比特定任务的替代办法更具普遍性和独立性(Voorhees,2004年,例如:新金;),甚至转移到其他方式(Jing等人,2024年;Martin等人,2026年)。 这两处财产是处理索赔而不是处理整份文件的动机。 索赔完全暴露了所声称的事实,区分了我们的做法和以原始文本为条件更新条款的方法(Gangi Reddy等,2026年)。 将来源减少为索赔首先明确了每个变化对何种知识的贡献。

blocks.en: 3 Knowledge Pull Requests
blocks.zh: 3 知识拉动请求

blocks.en: A Knowledge Pull Request (KPR) is a structured process for integrating new knowledge from a set of source documents into a main document. We define the core components below.
blocks.zh: 一个"知识拉出请求"(Knowledge Public Request (KPR))是一个将一组源文件的新知识集成为主文档的有条理的过程. 我们界定以下核心组成部分。

blocks.en: A KPR operates over two inputs: a main document and a set of sources . The main document (hereafter, main ) is a previously written document on a given topic. The sources are documents containing potentially new knowledge relevant to the main’s topic. The goal of a KPR is to integrate information from the sources into the main, working with its existing content rather than overwriting it.
blocks.zh: KPR 操作有两种输入:主要文件和一套来源。 主要文件(以下简称正文)是以前就某一专题所撰写的文件. 这些资料来源是载有可能与主要专题有关的新知识的文件。 一项《科索沃进度报告》的目标是将信息来源的信息纳入主要内容,与其重复,不如使用现有内容。

blocks.en: KPRs operate at the level of claims : atomic, decontextualized factual statements ( Gunjal and Durrett, 2024 , see) extracted from the sources and the main. Operating at the claim level, rather than the passage level, enables precise tracking of what knowledge is being proposed, where in the main it should be placed, and whether it conflicts with existing content.
blocks.zh: KPRs在索赔一级运作:从来源和主要来源中提取的原子性、解密的事实陈述(Gunjal和Durrett, 2024年,见)。 在索赔一级而不是通过一级开展工作,能够准确跟踪所拟议的知识,主要应放在何处,以及是否与现有内容相冲突。

blocks.en: The key artifact produced by a KPR is a ChangeLog : a structured, reviewable record of the proposed changes to the main. A ChangeLog consists of two components:
blocks.zh: KPR生产的关键文物是"变换日志"(ChangerLog:一个结构化的,可审查的关于拟作主修改的记录). 变化日志由两个部分组成:

blocks.en: Claim Proposal. A mapping of new claims extracted from the sources to the sections of the main document 2 2 2 We use sections throughout, but a KPR can operate over any granularity of the main (sentences, paragraphs, or pages). where they are proposed to be added, including new ones where needed. A candidate claim is mapped if it is not filtered by coverage (main already contains it) or against the document’s authoring criterion (query relevance or authoring guidelines 3 3 3 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:What_Wikipedia_is_not#Encyclopedic_content ). The claim proposal is also where the KPR flags knowledge conflicts (merge conflicts) ( Xu et al., 2024 , inter-context conflicts;) : cases where a proposed claim contradicts an existing claim in main. Rather than silently resolving these conflicts, the KPR surfaces them for review ( Thorne et al., 2018 ) . A human reviewer can adjudicate flagged conflicts, approve or reject claims, and reverse filtering decisions made in the proposal.

blocks.en: Document diff. A record of the proposed textual changes to the main, showing how the document would read after the proposed claims are integrated. Together, the claim proposal and diff let a reviewer inspect both what knowledge is being added (the claim proposal) and how the document text changes as a result (the diff).
blocks.zh: 文档diff。 记录了对主要部分的拟议文字改动,说明在将拟议索赔合并后如何阅读该文件。 索赔提案和diff一起让审查员检查所增加的知识(索赔提案)以及文件文本如何因此而变化(diff)。

blocks.en: The ChangeLog is what distinguishes a KPR from a simple rewrite. By separating the knowledge-level proposal from the text-level changes, it enables collaborative continual authoring. A human reviewer can assess proposed claims on their merits, resolve conflicts, and approve or reject changes before they are merged into main, analogous to a code review in software engineering.
blocks.zh: ChangeLog是KPR与简单的重写之间的区别. 通过将知识层面的提议与文本层面的改动区分开来,可以继续合作编写。 人文审查员可以评估拟议索赔的案情,解决冲突,并批准或拒绝修改,然后将其合并为主,类似于软件工程中的代码审查.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Source claims are classified against the main’s claims as absent, conflicting, or supported. Absent claims are filtered for relevance and routed to a section, conflicting claims are flagged for review, and supported and irrelevant claims are dropped.
blocks.zh: 图3:来源索赔与主要索赔的分类是不存在、相互冲突或得到支持。 现有索赔经过过滤后与相关,并转到一节,相互冲突的索赔被标出供审查,并有支持和不相关的索赔被撤销。

blocks.en: 4 Method for KPRs
blocks.zh: 4 关键PR方法

blocks.en: We introduce a three-stage baseline for producing KPRs. The first stage decomposes the sources into claims. The second produces a claim proposal by filtering claims already covered by or irrelevant to the main, flagging knowledge conflicts, and routing the remainder to sections. Finally, the third rewrites the new and affected sections to produce the diff.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了生产KPR的三阶段基线. 第一阶段将资料来源分解为索赔。 第二种方式是过滤已经涵盖或与主要部分无关的索赔,标出知识冲突,并将其余部分划入各科,从而提出索赔建议。 最后,第三回重写了新的和受影响的部分来制作diff.

blocks.en: Using an LLM, we decompose the sources into sets of atomic, decontextualized claims, giving a set of candidate claims to be potentially added to the main. The main is decomposed with the same method, but its claims are decomposed offline and cached as an index rather than online as with the sources. For non-English sources, we decompose directly into English rather than translating first, which yields more faithful claims ( Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 利用LLM,我们把来源分解成一组原子化,解构化的主张,使一组候选主张有可能被添加到主体. 主体采用同一种方法分解,但其主张被分解出线下并被缓存为指数,而不是和来源一样在线. 对于非英语来源,我们直接分解为英语,而不是先翻译,这会产生更忠实的诉求(附录C.

blocks.en: For each candidate claim, the KPR makes four decisions: (1) coverage , whether the claim is already covered by the main’s claims; (2) conflict , whether it contradicts an existing claim in the main; (3) relevance , whether the claim meets the document’s authoring criterion; and (4) routing , which section a new, non-conflicting, relevant claim belongs in. Coverage and conflict are resolved in a single classification pass labeling source claims as covered , conflicting , or absent . Relevance is then applied to the absent claims, against the information request in the RAGTIME setting, and left unfiltered in the Wikipedia setting, where candidates already come from articles authored with the same guidelines. Routing maps absent, relevant claims to an existing section or proposes a new one. Covered and irrelevant claims are dropped and conflicting claims are flagged for review.
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选索赔,科索沃人民法院作出四项决定:(1) 范围,索赔是否已经包括在主要索赔中;(2) 冲突,它是否与一项现有索赔主要相矛盾;(3) 相关性,索赔是否符合文件的编写标准;和(4) 路线,哪一节属于一个新的、非相冲突的相关索赔。 覆盖和冲突通过单一的分类合格证来解决,标出覆盖、冲突或不存在的源索赔。 然后,根据RAGTIME设置中的信息请求,将相关性应用于不存在的主张,而未过滤到维基百科设置中,其中候选人已经来自由同一准则所撰写的文章。 在没有地图的情况下,向现有部分提出相关要求,或提出新的地图。 所涵盖和无关的索赔被撤销,相互冲突的索赔被标出供审查。

blocks.en: We then apply the claim proposal to the main, one section at a time. Each section (new or existing) that receives one or more claims is rewritten to integrate them, while sections with no proposed claims are left unchanged. Diffing the resulting document against the original main gives the document diff.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将索赔提案适用于主要部分,一个部分。 每一个收到一项或多项索赔要求的款(新或已存在)都会被改写,以便合并,而没有拟议索赔要求的款次则保持不变。 将生成的文档从原始主文档中除去则给出了文档 diff.

blocks.en: Figure 4: The approved claim proposal is integrated into each new and affected section, and diffing the result against the original gives the document diff. Sections with no proposed claims are left unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图 4: 核准的索赔提案纳入每个新的受影响的部分,并将结果与原始内容相对照,给出文件。 没有拟议索赔要求的章节保持不变。

blocks.en: 4.1 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 基线

blocks.en: We compare KPRs against three methods that integrate the sources without a claim proposal.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了KPRs和三种没有索赔建议的整合来源的方法.

blocks.en: ConText (Concatenate Text) is our adaptation of WiNELL Gangi Reddy et al. (2026) . It conditions each section’s rewrite on raw source text and performs no claim decomposition. In place of WiNELL’s retrieval step, an LLM classifies whether a source contains information relevant to that section, also to mirror our claim routing.
blocks.zh: ConText(Concatenate Text)是WINELL Gangi Reddy等(2026)的改编. 它将每个部分的重写以原始源文本作为条件,不进行索赔分解。 作为WINELL检索步骤的替代,一个LLM对一个来源是否包含与该部分有关的信息进行分类,也是为了反映我们的索赔路线。

blocks.en: ConClaim (Concatenate Claims) differs from ConText only in conditioning on source claims rather than source text. Exactly as in KPR, sources are decomposed into claims and those claims are routed to sections. The only difference from KPR is that ConClaim applies no coverage, conflict, or relevance filtering, conditioning each section’s rewrite on all claims routed to it. ConClaim is therefore equivalent to a KPR without claim review.
blocks.zh: 索赔(附带索赔)与Context不同,只是在对来源索赔的限定上,而不是来源文本上。 与KPR案一样,资料来源被分解为索赔,这些索赔被转到各科。 与KPR的唯一区别在于,Conclaim没有适用覆盖、冲突或相关过滤,在它所处理的所有索赔中规定每个部分的重写。 因此,索赔相当于未经索赔审查的库尔德人索赔。

blocks.en: Scratch regenerates the document from all sources in one pass, discarding the standing document entirely. This follows how a query-driven or deep-research system answers an updated query. We use it in the RAGTIME setting only, where regeneration is the standard alternative to updating when new sources surface.
blocks.zh: 将文档从所有来源复制到一个通道,完全丢弃站立文档。 这跟随了查询驱动或深度研究系统如何回答更新的查询. 我们只在RAGTIME设置中使用,其中再生是新来源出现时更新的标准替代.

blocks.en: All baselines produce their document diff the same way as KPR, by diffing the rewritten document against the original main.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都以与 KPR 相同的方式生成文件 diff, 方法是将重写的文件相对于原始主文件来进行 diff 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: All uses of an LLM—classification, routing, and rewriting—use Qwen3.5-27B ( Team, 2026 ) . Because ConText, ConClaim, and KPRs operate over document sections, the two evaluation settings differ in how sections are obtained. For Wikipedia, articles are already organized into sections, so all methods operate on the native section structure. For RAGTIME, system-generated reports do not generally have a section structure, but for our experiments we impose one on the round-1 reports so that every method can operate section by section. A KPR requires only a span the document can be rewritten in, not a pre-existing header, so imposing an outline is sufficient.
blocks.zh: 所有LLM的用途——分类、路由和重写——使用Quen3.5-27B(Team,2026年)。 由于ConText、ConClaim和KPR在文件章节上运行,两种评价设置在章节的获取方式上有所不同。 对于维基百科来说,文章已经被组织成各节,因此所有的方法都运行在原生部分的结构上. 对于RAGTIME来说,系统生成的报告一般没有分节结构,但是对于我们的实验,我们对第1轮报告施加一个分节结构,以便每一种方法可以逐节操作. KPR 只要求一个跨度的文档可以被重写,而不是一个先前存在的标题,所以强制一个大纲就足够了.

blocks.en: Our experiments have no human reviewer, so any claims flagged as conflicts are withheld from the rewrite rather than resolved. Resolving a conflict means deciding which source to believe, and adjudicating source trust remains an open problem, so we withhold conflicts as a default.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验没有人类审查员,所以任何标注为冲突的主张都不得重写而不予解决. 解决冲突意味着决定哪个来源可以相信,判断来源信任仍然是一个公开的问题,所以我们扣下冲突作为默认.

blocks.en: 5 Revising Cross-lingual Knowledge Across Wikipedia with KPRs
blocks.zh: 5 用 KPR 修改整个维基百科的跨文化知识

blocks.en: Our first application, cross-lingual knowledge revision, integrates knowledge from one language edition of Wikipedia into another. Events, entities, and locations are often documented unevenly across editions, covered more thoroughly in the language of the region they concern and sparsely elsewhere, depending on the distribution of volunteer editors. Each edition is therefore a source of human-authored knowledge that may be missing from or in conflict with another.
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个应用——跨语言知识修订——将维基百科的一个语言版本的知识整合到另一个语言版本. 不同版本的事件、实体和地点往往记录不均,以他们所关注区域的语言更全面地报道,其他地方则很少,这取决于志愿人员编辑的分布情况。 因此,每一版都是人类授权知识的来源,可能与另一版相去甚远。

blocks.en: We treat English Wikipedia as the main and its counterparts in other languages as sources. Our task is thus to revise the English article with knowledge from the other sources while preserving its existing content. This tests whether a KPR can work from existing, curated text rather than newly surfaced information. Our documents come from MegaWika 2.0 ( Barham et al., 2025 ) , whose collections ( Barham et al., 2023 ; Barham et al., 2025 ) are built specifically for broad multilingual Wikipedia coverage with aligned articles across languages.
blocks.zh: 我们把英语维基百科作为主语,其他语言的对应语源. 因此,我们的任务是根据其他来源的知识修订英文文章,同时保留其现有内容。 这个测试一个 KPR 能否从已有的,被整理的文本中,而不是从新浮出水面的信息中工作. 我们的文件来自MegaWika 2.0(Barham等,2025年),其收藏(Barham等,2023年;Barham等,2025年)是专门为多种语言的维基百科广泛报道而制作的,各语言的文章一致。

blocks.en: We evaluate these rewrites along three dimensions: the quality of the rewritten article, the edit cost of accepting it, and its value as a grounding source for downstream question answering. Appendix D gives more evaluation details.
blocks.zh: 我们按照三个维度来评价这些重写:重写文章的质量,接受文章的编辑成本,以及它作为下游问答的地基来源的价值. 附 录 D提供了更多的评价细节。

blocks.en:
Quality. We measure quality with MiRAGE ( Martin et al., 2026 ) . Information precision ( InfoP ) is a source-constrained variant of FActScore: each claim in the rewrite is verified against the documents used to produce it, checking that added claims faithfully reflect their sources rather than being distorted during rewriting. We adapt information recall ( InfoR ) to measure the coverage of two distinct claim sets: (1) InfoR-R (retain), the
original English claims preserved in the rewrite, and (2) InfoR-A (add), source claims that are added in the rewrite. These capture whether the rewrite preserves existing content and adds the intended new content, respectively.
blocks.zh:
质量. 我们用MIRAGE(Martin等人,2026年)测量质量。 信息精度(InfoP)是FActScore的一个受源限制的变体:重写中的每一项索赔都根据用来制作的文件进行核实,检查添加的索赔是否忠实地反映了其来源,而不是在重写过程中被扭曲. 我们调整了信息召回(InformationR),以衡量两套不同的索赔的覆盖范围: (1)信息R(保留),
原英文索赔保留于重写中,和(2)InformR-A(add),源索赔被重写中添加. 这些记录了重写是否分别保留了已存在的内容并添加了预定的新内容.

blocks.en: Grounding Source. We test how well each rewritten article serves as a grounding source for question answering. To build the QA set, we take the decomposed claims from the English and multilingual articles, generate QA pairs from them, and filter for quality (answerable, not context-dependent, well-answered), yielding English and multilingual splits. With the two splits, we measure whether the rewrite loses existing knowledge (En-QA) and whether it adds the new cross-lingual knowledge (Multi-QA).
blocks.zh: 地基来源. 我们检验每篇重写的文章 如何成为回答问题的基础 为了构建QA集,我们从英文和多语种文章中取出被分解的主张,从中产生QA对,并过滤质量(可回答,不依赖上下文,答得好),产生英语和多语种的分解. 通过两种分法,我们衡量重写是否失去已存在的知识(En-QA),以及它是否添加了新的跨语言知识(Multi-QA).

blocks.en: Edit Cost. We measure edit cost from the perspective of a reviewer who must review and approve a method’s changes to a document. From a word-level diff between the main M M and the rewrite R R , we report five quantities: word edit rate ( WER ), the word-level Levenshtein distance per source word; Click , the number of contiguous edit blocks the reviewer must approve, regardless of their size; added tokens ( Tok ), the number of new tokens generated; preservation ( Presv ), the fraction of the main untouched; and expansion ( Add ), the length ratio R M \frac{R}{M} . WER, Click, and Tok measure the cost of producing and reviewing a rewrite, while Presv and Add describe the shape of the rewrite.
blocks.zh: 编辑成本。 我们从审查者的角度衡量编辑费用,审查者必须审查和批准对文件的修改方法。 从主 M M 和重写 R R 之间的单词级别 diff 中, 我们报告出五个量: 单词编辑率( WER), 每个源词的单词级别 Levenshtein 相距; 点击, 复刻器必须批准的相接编辑块数, 不管其大小; 添加符号( Tok), 生成的新符号数; 保存 (Presv), 主未受影响的分数; 扩展 (Add), 长度比 R\frac{ R}{M}. WER, Click, 和 Tok 测量重写器的产生和审查成本, 而 Presv和Add 描述重写器的形状.

blocks.en: 5.1 Article Quality
blocks.zh: 5.1 第5.1条 质量

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the InfoP and the two InfoR variants. We find that conditioning on claims rather than raw text (ConText vs. ConClaim) raises both the precision and the recall of added information. When adding the claim proposal (ConClaim vs. KPR), both precision and recall rise again, with the larger gain in added information. Retention is high for every method, so the methods differ mainly in how much of the source knowledge they integrate, where KPRs see the largest benefit.
blocks.zh: 表2报告InfoP和两个InfoR变体。 我们认为,对索赔而不是原始文本(ConText vs. Conquest)的限定,既提高了补充信息的准确性,也提高了对信息的召回。 在增加索赔建议(Conclaim vs. KPR)时,精确度和召回率都再次上升,在增加的资料方面收益更大。 每种方法保留率都很高,因此方法主要在融合了多少源知识上有所不同,其中KPR看到最大的好处.

blocks.en: 5.2 Grounding Source
blocks.zh: 5.2 地基来源

blocks.zh: 表1在五个条件下报告每个模型的准确性:没有文件(封闭本)、原始主(EW)和每个重写后的主(Context、ConClaim和KPR)。

blocks.en: The unchanged article is a poor grounding source, averaging below even closed-book, because the queried facts are absent from the English article, and some models abstain rather than guess. 4 4 4 Gemma-4 and Qwen3.5 faithfully abstain on around 70%. All three rewrites recover some of this missing knowledge, but the KPR method recovers substantially more than either baseline. This shows the downstream impact of KPR’s high InfoR (add), demonstrating KPRs incorporate multilingual information in a way that grounding articles can properly utilize.
blocks.zh: 文章内容未变, 来源不足, 平均低于封闭账本, 因为英文文章中缺少被质疑的事实, 4 4 4 Gemma-4和Quen3.5忠实地弃权了约70%. 所有三个重写都恢复了这些缺失的知识,但KPR方法的恢复大大超过两个基线。 这表明KPR的高信息R(添加)的下游影响,表明KPR将多语种信息纳入其中,使文章能够正确使用。

blocks.en: On questions about content already in the English article, the unchanged article scores highest (EW). All three rewrites degrade QA performance slightly, but stay within half a percent of one another, so integrating the cross-lingual knowledge does not meaningfully cost existing content for any method. KPR therefore obtains its multilingual gains without giving up English performance relative to the baselines.
blocks.zh: 关于英文文章中已有的内容问题,未修改的文章得分最高(EW). 所有这三种重写都略微地降低质量评估的性能,但保持相去不远的半分之一,所以融合跨语言知识不会使任何方法的现有内容产生有意义的成本. 因此,KPR在不放弃英语相对于基线的性能的情况下获得其多语种收益.

blocks.en: The KPR advantage does not require a large model to exploit the rewritten article. On smaller models ( Table 3 ), we still find that conditioning on the KPR-revised article provides a strong lift in performance. Small models running locally are exactly where a personal, grounded wiki is most useful. 5 5 5 As envisioned by Karpathy: https://gist.github.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f A KPR gives such a setup a document worth grounding on, without a frontier model or a search service in the loop.
blocks.zh: KPR的优势不需要大型模型来利用重写的文章. 关于较小的型号(表3),我们仍然认为,对《韩国减贫战略》修订条款的限定能有力地提升业绩。 本地运行的小型模型正是个人,被禁足的维基最有用的地方. 5 5 由Karopathy设想:https://gist.github.com/karopathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f KPR 提供了这样一份值得支撑的文件,没有前沿模型或循环搜索服务.

blocks.en: In Table 4 , we test whether grounding on a KPR is worth it over a frontier model with search. We create a QA set of the hardest questions by taking a random sample of 100 multilingual QA instances that no dense model could answer. On this set, we again see that grounding on KPR recovers the most answers at every scale. 6 6 6 We provide baseline conditioned results in Appendix A . We additionally give Sol-5.6 access to web search, and it recovers only marginally more answers than EW. Because the questions are posed in English, while the answer may only be documented in its source language, we translate each question to its source language for closed book (CB-T) and web search (WS-T). This helps both, but neither approaches KPR, and even the smallest 7B model grounded on the KPR article outperforms the frontier model with search in either condition.
blocks.zh: 在表4中,我们测试在KPR上打地基是否值得通过搜索的前沿模型. 我们通过随机抽取100个没有密集模型能够回答的多语种QA实例来创建一套QA最难的问题. 在这个场景上,我们再次看到,在KPR上打下地基,在每个尺度上都能找到最多的答案. 6、6、6 我们在附录A中提供基线有条件的结果。 此外,我们给予Sol-5.6访问网络搜索的机会,它只得到略多于EW的答案。 由于问题用英语提出,虽然答案可能只能用其源语言来记录,但我们将每个问题翻译到源语言中,用于封闭书籍(CB-T)和网络搜索(WS-T). 这对两者都有帮助,但两者都不接近KPR,即使是基于KPR文章的最小的7B模型,在两种情况下的搜索都超过了前沿模型.

blocks.en: The sources are other-language Wikipedia editions, so the knowledge is public and indexed, but not surfaced by search. Having access to a KPR-revised document provides a more reliable grounding source than relying on search at query time.
blocks.zh: 来源为其他语言的维基百科版本,因此该知识是公开的并有索引的,但不会被搜索而浮出水面. 访问KPR修改后的文件比依赖查询时间的搜索提供了更可靠的地基源.

WER: word edit rate, Click: number of contiguous edits a reviewer must approve, Tok: added tokens, Presv: percentage of the original document preserved in the rewrite, Add: length of the rewrite relative to the original document.

blocks.en: 5.3 Edit Cost
blocks.zh: 5.3 编辑费用

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the cost of authoring and reviewing the revisions and their shape. We find that KPRs preserve the most of the article and make changes in the smallest number of contiguous edits. While both ConText and KPRs add a similar number of new tokens (2.3 × \times context increase), KPRs integrate substantially more of the source knowledge and require a reviewer looking at the text to approve fewer separate changes. ConClaim makes the smallest change to the article overall, but requires more than twice the approvals of a KPR. Without a claim proposal, every claim routed to a section is passed to the rewrite, so the model revises content that did not need to change.
blocks.zh: 表5报告编写和审查订正案的费用及其形式。 我们发现 KPRs 保存了大部分文章,并对最小的相接编辑数量进行修改. 虽然ConText和KPRs都添加了相近数量的新令牌(2.3×\times上下文增加),但KPRs将大量源知识整合,需要一位审查者来查看文本,以批准较少的单独更改. 申诉对该条的修改是最小的,但要求得到科索沃共和国批准的两倍以上。 没有索赔建议,每个被转到一节的索赔都会被转给重写,所以模型修改了不需要修改的内容.

blocks.en: 6 Updating Query-Driven Report Generation with KPRs
blocks.zh: 6 与 KPR 一起更新 Query- Driven 报告生成

blocks.en: Our second application moves from a single evolving article to query-driven report generation, where the document is a report synthesized to answer a query and the sources are documents retrieved for it. This setting is harder than the Wikipedia revision in two ways. First, the sources are no longer aligned versions of the same article. Instead, they are independent documents that may overlap with, extend, or contradict one another and the existing report. Second, reports are regenerated as new sources surface—a query asked today may be re-answered next month against updated evidence—which is precisely where query-driven systems are weakest. Current deep research and report-generation systems regenerate from scratch Google (2025) , discarding prior content as wasted compute. A KPR instead treats each regeneration as an incremental update to the standing report.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二个应用程序从一个单一的演进中的文章转向了以查询驱动的报告生成,其中文档是用于回答查询而合成的报告,而来源是为此检索的文档. 这个设置在两个方面都比维基百科修订版更难. 首先,资料来源已不再是同一篇文章的统一版本。 相反,它们是相互重叠、延伸或相互矛盾的独立文件。 第二,报告是作为新的来源重新生成的——今天提出的询问可能在下个月根据更新的证据重新回答——这正是查询驱动系统最薄弱的地方。 目前深入研究和报告生成系统从google抓取(2025年)再生出,丢弃先前的内容作为被浪费的计算. 相反,《韩国减贫战略》将每次再生视为对常备报告的一种渐进更新。

blocks.zh: 表6:每场比赛的RAGTIME结果。 InfoR-R:从第1轮报告中保留信息召回;InfoR-A:从第2轮来源添加信息召回. 对于第1轮报告(R1 Main),InfoR-R是原报告中对第1轮元的召回.

blocks.en: We build our experiments on RAGTIME ( Lawrie et al., 2026 ) , a multilingual report-generation task in which a system is given a persona and query and performs retrieval-augmented generation over a collection of multilingual documents. 7 7 7 We do not perform retrieval; we use the relevance judgments to obtain the source documents directly. From RAGTIME we construct three two-round variants of the task and report their details in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们建立了我们关于RAGTIME(Lawrie等,2026年)的实验,这是一项多语种报告生成任务,在这个任务中,一个系统被赋予了个性,并且通过收集多语种文件进行检索生成。 7 7 我们不进行检索;我们利用相关判断直接获取源文件。 从RAGTIME来看,我们构建了三项两轮任务变体,并在附录B中报告详细情况。

blocks.en: Temporal : new information arrives over time. RAGTIME metadata contains the document date, so we set a per-topic knowledge cutoff such that half the relevant documents surface only in round 2, simulating the same query asked at two times.
blocks.zh: 时间:新信息随时间推移而来。 RAGTIME元数据包含文件日期,因此我们设定了每个专题的知识截断,这样,一半的相关文件只在第2轮中浮出水面,模拟了两次询问的相同问题.

blocks.en: Conflict : a round-2 source contradicts round-1 content. RAGTIME nuggets, QA evaluation units similar to atomic facts ( Voorhees, 2004 ) , sometimes take different values across documents (e.g., a margin of victory reported as 2.7% in one and 3% in another). We construct these rounds so that conflicting nuggets appear in each.
blocks.zh: 相冲突:一回合出处与一回合内容相矛盾. RAGTIME nuggets,与原子事实相类似的QA评价单位(Voorhees,2004年),有时在文档中取取不同的值(例如,一个和另一个的胜率报告为2.7%). 我们造出这些回合,使相冲突的元件出现在每一回合中。

blocks.en: Balanced : information is split evenly, with an equal number of nuggets appearing in round-1 and round-2, maximizing how much a method must add while still preserving round-1.
blocks.zh: 平衡:信息均匀分取出,第1轮和第2轮出现相同数量的分币,在保留第1轮的同时,尽量扩大方法必须增加多少.

blocks.en: To generate the round-1 report, we condition on the text the way a RAG system might put the relevant documents in context with the query to write the report. We evaluate report quality with MiRAGE ( Martin et al., 2026 ) , which has higher human agreement than AutoArgue ( Walden et al., 2026 ) on this task, using the same information metrics from the Wikipedia experiments. InfoP measures precision against the sources used in generation, InfoR-R (retain) the round-1 nuggets preserved in the updated report, and InfoR-A (add) the round-2 nuggets newly incorporated. We omit ConClaim in this setting, as the unfiltered claim sets from RAGTIME’s source documents exceed the context window.
blocks.zh: 为了产生第1轮报告,我们以文字为条件,即RAG系统如何将相关文件与编写报告的查询联系起来。 我们用MiraGE(Martin等,2026年)来评价报告的质量,因为对于这项任务,MiraGE比AutoArgue(Walden等,2026年)有更高的人类共识,使用维基百科实验中相同的信息度量. InfoP对生成中使用的源进行精确度测量,InfoR-R(保留)更新报告中保存的圆一分块,和InfoR-A(添加)新加入的圆二分块. 在此情况下,我们省略了索赔,因为RAGTIME源文件中未过滤的索赔超过上下文窗口。

WER: word edit rate, Click: number of contiguous edits a reviewer must approve, Tok: added tokens, Presv: percentage of the original document preserved in the rewrite, Add: length of the rewrite relative to the original document.

blocks.en: 6.1 Report Quality
blocks.zh: 6.1 报告质量

blocks.en: Table 6 reports the InfoP and the two InfoR variants across all three settings. KPR achieves the highest recall of both round-1 and round-2 nuggets in every setting, and leads on precision among the rewrites. Scratch adds the least information between rounds, while ConText has the lowest precision of any method in every setting. The round-1 report scores highest on precision, only needing to be faithful to the round-1 sources.
blocks.zh: 表6报告所有三种设置的InfoP和两个InfoR变体。 KPR在每个场合都实现了回合一分和回合二分币的最高回想,并导致重写中的精度. Scratch在回合之间添加了最少的信息,而ConText在每个设置中任意方法的精度最低. 回合一号报告在精确度上得分最高,只需要忠实于回合一号来源.

blocks.en: Every method recalls more round-1 nuggets than the round-1 report. The incremental methods never revisit the round-1 documents, but some round-1 information recurs in round-2, so integrating those sources recovers nuggets the original missed.
blocks.zh: 每一种方法都比第1轮报告更能回顾出第1轮金币. 增量方法从不重温第1轮文件,但一些第2轮信息重复出现,因此综合这些来源可以恢复原先丢失的碎片.

blocks.en: When sources disagree across rounds, ConText integrates less of the round-2 information than it did in either other setting. Without a mechanism to flag conflicts it must resolve them implicitly during the rewrite, and doing so appears to suppress how much of the incoming information it incorporates. KPR instead withholds conflicting claims, adding new facts at a rate comparable to the other settings while holding the highest precision of any method that integrates a meaningful amount.
blocks.zh: 当来源在相轮之间出现分歧时,ConText集成的回合-2信息比其他两种情况下都少. 如果没有一种机制来标出冲突,它就必须在改写时隐含地解决这些冲突,这样做似乎会压制它所收集的多少信息。 相反,KPR扣留了相冲突的索赔,以与其他设置相仿的费率增加了新的事实,同时保持了任何整合有意义数额的方法的最高精确性。

blocks.en: 6.2 Edit Cost
blocks.zh: 6.2 编辑费用

blocks.en: Table 7 reports the cost of authoring and reviewing each update. We find that Scratch’s high precision makes sense in the context of its edit shape, generating short, but high-confidence reports. This also makes it the most expensive to review, as only coincidental n-gram overlaps are preserved in the generation. ConText and KPR instead make similarly sized updates to the round-1 document, but ConText struggles to add as much information to the updates as KPR.
blocks.zh: 表7报告编写和审查每次更新的费用。 我们发现Scratch的高精度在它的编辑形状上是有道理的,生成了短而高的自信报告. 这也使得审查费用最昂贵,因为只有相巧合的正克重叠在一代中得以保留. ConText和KPR转而对回合一文档进行类似大小的更新,但ConText挣扎着要像KPR一样在更新中添加同样多的信息.

blocks.en: 7 Findings Across Settings
blocks.zh: 7 跨设置结果

blocks.en: We demonstrate that claims are a better unit of information to operate over than text when integrating knowledge. In both experiments, conditioning the rewrite on claims rather than source text improves both the precision and the recall of added information, with the same trend showing in the QA experiments. Claim-level representations are known to be the appropriate unit for factuality evaluation ( Min et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2024 ) and can even boost retrieval performance ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Our results extend this finding to knowledge integration, where conditioning generation on claims rather than source text yields a more faithful grounding document.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,在整合知识时,与文字相比,权利主张是一个更好的信息单元。 在两项实验中,对索赔重写而不是源文本的限定,既能提高附加信息的精确度又能召回性,在质量保证实验中也显示出同样的趋势. 据了解,索赔层次的表述是进行事实评估的适当单位(Min等,2023;Song等,2024),甚至可以提高检索绩效(Chen等,2024)。 我们的结果将这一结论扩展至知识的融合,在知识的融合中,以权利要求而不是原始文本为条件产生更忠实的基础文件。

blocks.en: We find that claim proposals consistently improve the quality of the rewrite over the baselines, maintaining precision and raising the recall of integrated information. The proposal also helps shape the rewrite into contiguous, easy to review edits. A KPR also adds the most information per token generated, as baselines writing a comparable volume of text integrate substantially less of the source information.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,这项索赔建议不断提高重写基线的质量,保持准确性并增加综合信息的召回。 提案还帮助将重写成相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相 由于编写可比数量文本的基线吸收了相当少的源信息,因此每个符号所产生的信息最多。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Knowledge Pull Requests, which reframe continual document authoring as a reviewable, knowledge-level operation rather than an uninterpretable rewrite. By decomposing sources into claims, filtering and routing them, and surfacing conflicts, a KPR produces a ChangeLog that separates what knowledge changes from how the text changes. Across cross-lingual Wikipedia revision and query-driven report updating, KPRs integrate new information more completely and preserve existing content better than other methods, while concentrating their changes into contiguous edits a reviewer can approve. By making the unit of change a reviewable claim rather than an opaque edit, KPRs open a path toward collaborative, human-in-the-loop authoring.
blocks.zh: 我们提出知识拉动请求,将持续编写的文件重新设定为可审查的知识级操作,而不是不可解释的重写。 通过将来源分解为债权,过滤和路由,以及表面冲突,一个 KPR 生成一个 ChangeLog,将知识的改变与文本的改变区分开来. 通过跨语言的维基百科修订和由查询驱动的报告更新,KPR更完整地整合了新信息,并比其他方法更好地保留了现有内容,同时将修改集中在一个审查者可以批准的相接编辑上. 通过使修改单位成为可审查的主张,而不是不透明的编辑,科索沃PR为合作的、即时的作者开辟了一条道路。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our pipeline performs every step—decomposition, classification, routing, and rewriting—with an LLM. While a KPR rewrites only the sections that change rather than regenerating the entire document, each intermediate step still requires an LLM call, and cheaper alternatives exist. For example, a lightweight encoder could classify claim containment or route claims to sections in place of prompting. Our edit-cost metrics measure the size and shape of the resulting rewrite, not the compute spent producing it. Reducing this per-step cost is important for deploying KPRs at scale (e.g., continually updating Wikipedia) and is left to future work.d
blocks.zh: 我们的管道用LLM进行每一个步骤——分解、分类、路线和重写。 虽然一个 KPR 只重写更改而非再生成整个文档的段落,但每个中间步骤仍然需要LLM调用,并且存在更便宜的替代品. 例如,轻量级编码器可将索赔封装或路由索赔分类到各段,以代替提示。 我们的编辑成本度量度测量了结果重写时的大小和形状,而不是所花费的计算. 减少这种每步成本对于大规模部署KPR(如不断更新维基百科)很重要,并留待未来工作. D. 国家

blocks.en: A central motivation for KPRs is that the ChangeLog is inspectable and reviewable. A human can assess proposed claims, resolve flagged conflicts, and approve or reject changes before they are merged, analogous to a code review. However, our experiments run the pipeline automatically, withholding flagged conflicts from the rewrite, and thus do not evaluate the review process itself. Human studies that investigate whether a ChangeLog makes an editor faster and more accurate than a text diff, and how claim proposals should be adjudicated by a human, are both necessary future work.
blocks.zh: 韩国减贫战略的一个核心动机是 " 变化日志 " 可以检查和审查。 一个人可以评估拟议索赔,解决标出的冲突,在合并之前批准或拒绝修改,类似于代码审查。 然而,我们的实验自动运行管道,避免了重写中标出的冲突,因此不评估审查过程本身。 调查 " 更改日志 " 是否使编辑比 " diff " 文本更快、更准确,以及人如何裁定索赔提案的人类研究,都是今后必要的工作。

blocks.en: To build the question-answering set that measures grounding, we convert every claim in an article into a question with the claim as its gold answer. For the multilingual split, we additionally discard claims that are contained by English Wikipedia, so that the remaining questions target knowledge genuinely available only in other language editions. We then filter the questions for quality and deduplicate them, keeping only questions that (i) are specific, well-formed factoid questions with a clear, verifiable answer; (ii) are answerable on their own, without external context (e.g., “who is the captain of the ship?” is discarded, as it depends on an unstated referent); and (iii) are cleanly and correctly answered by the gold answer, taking the claim as ground truth. Table 8 reports the number of questions remaining after each stage. We provide our prompts for filtering the data in Figure 10 , Figure 11 , and Figure 12 .
blocks.zh: 为了建立据以确定措施的问答机制,我们将文章中的每一项主张变成一个以主张为黄金答案的问题。 对于多语种分裂,我们进一步抛弃英语维基百科中包含的主张,使所剩问题针对的只是其他语言版真正可用的知识. 然后,我们过滤质量问题,加以简化,只保留以下问题:(一) 具体、造型良好、有明确、可核查答案的事实问题;(二) 自己可以回答,没有外部背景(例如,“谁是船长?” ) 被丢弃,因为它取决于一个未说明的参照人;(三) 用金子回答来清楚和正确地回答,把这一说法当作事实。 表8报告了每个阶段之后所剩问题的数量。 我们提供了过滤图10、图11和图12中数据的提示。

blocks.en: To construct this set, we filter the multilingual QA questions down to those not answered correctly by any of our dense models in a closed-book, non translated setting, and then sample 100 at random. This isolates questions whose answers are absent from the models’ parametric knowledge, so that any performance must come from the grounding document. For the translated versions of this subset (CB-T, WS-T), we translate questions with Qwen3.5-27B.

blocks.en: Claim decomposition is less straightforward across languages than within a single one. A claim must end up as an atomic, decontextualized statement in the target language, faithful to its meaning in the source language and without propagating translation errors. We compare three strategies ( Table 11 ): • Translate-then-decompose : translate the source sentence into the target language, then decompose claims from the translation. We use both the MegaWika NLLB translations Team et al. (2022) and Qwen3.5-9B. • Native-then-translate : decompose the sentence into claims in the source language, then translate those claims to the target language. • Cross-lingual decomposition : decompose the source sentence directly into claims in English. 8 8 8 Note that the English-to-English decomposition is there as an example baseline to compare the cross-lingual decomposition against. Translate-then-decompose is the least faithful under either translator, as translation errors compound with decomposition. Native-then-translate and cross-lingual decomposition achieve roughly the same faithfulness. We use cross-lingual decomposition because it uses a single LLM pass instead of two passes.

Figure 6: Claim-translation prompt. Translates
native-language claims into English one-to-one, without adding, removing or merging claims.

图6:索赔翻译迅速。 翻译
当地语言的债权变为英语的一对一,不增加,去除或合并债权.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Cross-lingual decomposition. Decomposes a non-English sentence directly into English claims, with no separate translation step.
blocks.zh: 图7:跨文化分解. 将非英语句子直接分解为英语索赔,没有单独的翻译步骤.

图8:判决翻译及时. 翻译 a

blocks.en: Figure 9: LLM-judge prompt. Fact-checks an English claim against a (possibly non-English) source sentence, returning one of four verdicts.

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Gold-answer fairness prompt. Judges whether a gold answer is a
fair grading key for a quiz item (GOOD / QUESTIONABLE / BAD), given the source
claim it was written from.
blocks.zh:
图10:金答公平快取. 判断一个黄金答案是否
测试项目的公平分级键(GOOD / 问题/ BAD),考虑到来源
声称这是从。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Standalone-answerability prompt. Judges whether a quiz question can be answered without its one hidden source document (SELF_CONTAINED / BORDERLINE / CONTEXT_DEPENDENT).
blocks.zh: 图11:独立可答性迅速. 判断一个问答问题是否可以在没有其一个隐藏源文件(SELF_Contained / BORDERLINE / ContentXT_DEPENT)的情况下解答.
